title: Company orders
note: Manual transfer of signed envelopes. No automatic sending, stock reservation or money movement.
identityNote: The key does not prove legal identity. Verify the company and fingerprint through an independent channel.
required: Owner review required; new exchanges blocked.
ready: No restore block reported by the service.
envelope: Paste only the public envelope (payload and signature)
quantity: Quantity in original unit (up to 3 decimals)
promised: Promised date — local date and time
check: I reviewed destination, quantity, deadline and effects. For trust/review, I verified the counterpart through an independent channel.
pendingNote: Query before resending. Explicit retry preserves the exact identifier and body. No automatic retry.
missing: Receipt not found. This does not authorize a new identifier for an uncertain operation.
failed: Action incomplete or invalid reply. Preserve pending data and query the receipt.
permission: Unavailable for current context or permissions.
storage: Storage or cross-tab lock unavailable. No new submission should start.
unavailable: Service unavailable or restore review required. Query recovery status.
readOnly: Read only: new operations require orders license, permission and cross-tab locking. Trust and recovery review are owner-only.
